tagging.title: Automatic sorting
tagging.description: Have a decision engine answer the same questions on every message of a mailbox.
tagging.mailboxDesc: Sorting is set per mailbox: engine, cap and progress belong to it.
tagging.noMailbox: Add a mailbox first: sorting works on the messages of one.
tagging.engineDesc: Chosen from the engines of Settings → AI Copilot.
tagging.noEngineHint: Add one in Settings → AI Copilot. Without an engine nothing is sorted.
tagging.budgetDesc: Sorting pauses as soon as the spend reaches this cap. Raise it when you are sure.
tagging.estimate: Estimated cost of sorting the rest
tagging.estimateDesc: {mails} messages left × {questions} questions, at this engine’s rate. Taxonomy {version}: a message already sorted under another version is sorted again.
tagging.estimateUnknown: Unknown as long as no engine is chosen.
tagging.restartDesc: Clears the cursor and the counters, then sorts everything again.
tagging.restartConfirm: Sort this mailbox from the beginning? The counters go back to zero.
tagging.sample: Try it on a sample of {size} messages
tagging.sampleDesc: Sorts {size} messages drawn at random across every folder, for about {cost}, then stops. Read the spread below before paying for the rest.
tagging.sampleDescUnknown: Sorts {size} messages drawn at random across every folder, then stops. The cost is unknown as long as no engine is chosen.
tagging.sampleConfirm: Sort a sample of {size} messages drawn at random? The counters go back to zero.
tagging.sampleState: Sample of {size}: {done} done. Seed {seed}: the same seed draws the same messages again.
tagging.distributionDesc: What the engine answered, question by question. This is what tells you whether the questions are worth asking on the whole mailbox.
tagging.distributionEmpty: Nothing sorted yet under the current taxonomy.
tagging.pausedBudget: The spending cap is reached. Raise it, then resume.
tagging.pausedCredit: The engine declined for lack of credit. Top it up, then resume.
tagging.pausedAuth: The engine refused the key. Check it in Settings → AI Copilot.
tagging.pausedNoEngine: No engine is chosen for this mailbox.
tagging.liveDesc: Tags new messages only; history is the job of the full sort.

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: {enabled} of {total} questions enabled. Every sorted mail gets one answer per enabled question; editing the instructions or criteria creates a new version.
questions.resetConfirm: Replace all your questions with the default set? Questions you added and your edits will be lost.
questions.deleteConfirm: Delete the question “{name}”? Tags already written stay in the database but will no longer be shown.
questions.typeHint_choice: The engine picks ONE option from the list (255 at most). Definition, boundary and examples guide its choice.
questions.typeHint_score: The engine places the mail on an ordered scale of 2 to 10 levels, lowest to highest. Drag to reorder.
questions.typeHint_noul: The engine answers yes or no: no criteria to fill in, everything lives in the instructions.
questions.stale: {count, plural, one {# mail on an older version} other {# mails on an older version}}
questions.staleHint: Some mails in this mailbox carry a tag written under an earlier version of this question.
questions.testRejected: Engine {model} returned no valid answer for this question.
questions.retagConfirm: Re-run the mailbox sort to ask this question again on {count, plural, one {# mail tagged} other {# mails tagged}} under an older version? Every re-run mail is billed.
questions.retagStarted: Sort restarted: the mails will be retagged on the scheduler’s next pass.
questions.bodyPreview: Body sent to the engine: {chars} characters
questions.reservedId: The id “{id}” is reserved for a rule detector: pick another one.

rules.title: Tagging rules
rules.description: {enabled} of {total} rules active. A rule sets its tags BEFORE the engine, without asking it anything; when it is authoritative, its question is no longer asked for that message.
rules.deleteConfirm: Delete the rule “{name}”? Tags it already set are kept.
rules.name: Name
rules.authoritativeHint: Questions settled by this rule are not asked to the engine for that message: fewer tokens, and the rule always wins.
rules.empty: No rule yet. A rule sets a tag without calling the engine: for whatever a simple criterion is enough to recognise.

groups.title: Question groups
groups.description: {conditional} of {total} groups are conditional. A group without a trigger is asked on every message (pass 1); a conditional group is only asked on messages whose trigger is true after pass 1: one more request, for those only.
groups.deleteConfirm: Remove the trigger of “{name}”? Its questions will be asked on every message, as before.
groups.name: Display name
groups.triggerHint: A “Tag” condition reads an answer already obtained for this message (rules or pass 1). A condition on a message field is read directly.
groups.empty: Every question is asked on every message. Make a group conditional to ask its questions only on the messages concerned.
groups.noFreeGroup: Every question group already has a trigger.

cost.passesDesc: Before starting: what each message costs given the active groups, at this engine’s rate.
cost.withGroupsUnknown: Unknown: run a sample to measure the share of messages that trigger each group.
cost.groupRateHint: Share read on the {mails} messages already tagged under the current definition of the question it reads, not on the whole mailbox.
